run_skills_command: run the hermes skills command to interactively configure disabled skills globally or per-platform
get_disabled_skills: get the set of disabled skill names from a config dict, optionally filtered by platform
save_disabled_skills: save a set of disabled skill names to a config dict, persisting globally or per-platform
list_all_skills: list all installed skills from the tools registry, ignoring their disabled state
toggle_by_category: toggle all skills within selected categories on or off at once
